title: Curious Curlicue Cuttlefish
statement: A small, lantern-eyed cuttlefish that drifts up to the glass whenever someone pauses, rippling looping, half-legible curlicues across its skin as if trying to read you and write back. Between visitors it rearranges the pebbles of its warm, kelp-lit grotto into spirals, never quite the same way twice.
